description: This is a test class for SendAsynchronousEventsTasklet, a component responsible for sending external events asynchronously within the Apache Fineract project. It contains unit tests verifying the tasklet's behavior such as batch processing, error handling, event message creation, and status updates.

classes.name: SendAsynchronousEventsTaskletTest
classes.description: A JUnit 5 test class for validating the behavior of SendAsynchronousEventsTasklet, specifically testing batch processing, error handling, message creation, and event status updates.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, setting up tenant context and mock configurations.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets the thread-local context after each test.

methods.name: configureExternalEventsProducerReadBatchSizeProperty
methods.description: Configures the mock FineractProperties object to simulate external event batch size behavior.

methods.name: givenBatchSize2WhenTaskExecutionThenSend2Events
methods.description: Test verifying that the tasklet correctly processes a batch of two events and sends them via the event producer.

methods.name: givenBatchSize2WhenEventSendFailsThenExecutionStops
methods.description: Test ensuring that if event sending throws an exception, processing halts and repositories are not marked as sent.

methods.name: givenOneEventWhenEventSentThenEventStatusUpdates
methods.description: Test verifying proper handling and successful processing of a single event.

methods.name: testExecuteShouldHandleNullAggregateId
methods.description: Test ensuring that null aggregate IDs are handled gracefully, assigning -1L as a fallback.

methods.name: givenEventBatchSizeIsConfiguredAs10WhenTaskExecutionThenEventReadPageSizeIsCorrect
methods.description: Test confirming that the event repository query uses the configured page size (10).

methods.name: createExternalEventView
methods.description: Helper method to generate mock ExternalEventView objects with specified properties.
